static_traits.name: Lin An
static_traits.family_status: Lives with grandparents, the home has a cat named Mater; family is overall supportive, but negative self-labeling has affected relationships with family
static_traits.social_status: Interactions with family affected by Self-denial, daily life more cautious due to Impaired self-esteem; overall having a supportive family
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological issues in the past; never received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: High cooperativeness, clear expression, able to specifically describe and Reflect on negative automatic thoughts; slightly tense but Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to label myself as 'clumsy' and add negative attributions to my own behavior, leading to a sense of self-inadequacy.
basic_info.core_demands: The pizza incident made me realize that self-labeling and negative attribution are affecting my self-esteem and daily life, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Most recently, while walking from one room to another, she dropped a pizza her grandmother had made on the floor; at the time she felt a moderate degree of stress and embarrassment, and subjectively experienced being 'judged' by her own behavior. After the event she began labeling herself 'I am so clumsy', attributing any subsequent small mistakes (such as spilling a drink or bumping into things) to 'clumsiness'; her self-confidence declined and she became more cautious in daily activities to avoid making mistakes again; her relationships with family were affected, but her grandparents are generally supportive and try to comfort her.

core_beliefs: I am clumsy / not good enough
I am a burden to my family

special_situations.event: On the way to the next room, dropped the pizza grandmother made on the floor
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake in front of family, it means I am clumsy and will be judged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes overly cautious afterwards, trying to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: Small mishaps in daily life, such as spilling a drink or bumping into things
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any small mistake occurs, it means I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labels oneself as 'clumsy' and becomes more cautious to avoid mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I always mess up; I cannot do anything well

special_situations.event: When grandparents comfort and support me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I need others' comfort, it means I am troubling my family, a burden
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces expressing needs, bears it alone, avoids seeking more support
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a burden to my family

special_situations.event: During idle moments prone to recalling mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not constantly recall and criticize myself, I will be unable to correct mistakes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps oneself busy, distracts attention by accompanying the cat or doing housework
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can only see my own mistakes, proving I am no good

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by family, seen as capable and reliable, not judged
core_conflict.fear: Fears being humiliated, looked down on for making mistakes, or being seen as adding a burden to the family
defense_goal: Reducing errors through self-constraint and excessive caution, in order to avoid being judged and to avoid troubling the family

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough burden who easily messes up
object_relations.object_representation: Supportive and caring family (imagined by herself as people who might judge her)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (family or counselor) mention mistakes or try to comfort and affirm her
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously understanding others' attention as judgment of one's clumsiness and unreliability (transference: fearing being judged / looked down on)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a tone primarily of self-blame and self-deprecation (such as 'I always mess up'), restrains expression of needs, polite and cautious, avoiding further discussion of own worth as much as possible.

manifestations: Overly cautious to avoid mistakes, self-restricting, careful even with simple tasks

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Being overly cautious to avoid mistakes
Still blames oneself harshly when comforted by others, finds it hard to directly accept support

exception_events.target_problem: When making mistakes or thinking of their own errors, the client usually labels themselves as 'clumsy' and repeatedly ruminates, leading to Decreased self-esteem and Increased stress.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In those moments of playing with the cat Mater or helping grandparents with housework, the client did not fall into self-labeling and rumination as usual, but focused more on the present, experiencing some sense of competence and feeling better.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: keeping oneself busy and engaged in concrete tasks; different support: connection with pets and family providing emotional support and distraction; different situation: focusing on the current activity, with less free time for rumination.

positive_force: Support from grandparents and the companionship of the cat Mater provide stable emotional support
In busy and engaged activities, can experience a sense of competence and reduce rumination
Has realized negative self-labels are affecting self-esteem and life, with motivation to change
negative_force: Self-evaluation marked by overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
In free time, tends to ruminate and apply mental filtering, focusing excessively on mistakes
Worries about others' judgment and has a personalization tendency of 'I am a burden'
Excessive caution leading to restricted action and Increased stress

target_behavior.behavior: After mistakes or small errors, engages in repeated self-criticism and labeling (such as 'I am clumsy / I always mess up')
antecedent: Small mishaps occur (dropping food, spilling drinks, bumping into things)
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes an accidental mistake and overgeneralizes it into a stable negative trait, worrying about being judged and humiliated by others
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and shame, gaining a subjective sense of control over uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, Increased stress, affected interactions with family, worsened daily task efficiency and experience

target_behavior.behavior: Overly cautious and self-restricting to avoid mistakes
antecedent: When doing housework or simple tasks
Scenarios of interacting with family, fearing mistakes again
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being seen as clumsy or a burden, internalizing 'making mistakes = being utterly worthless' as a rule
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential criticism and shame, reducing Anxiety brought by uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Simple tasks become tense, efficiency drops, quality of life suffers
